dict.string: The Camera app takes a photo when you look at the Shutter square.
Connects to the BrainSync server on the laptop over your Wi-Fi.
Listens to the conversation partner so the user's reply options fit what was said.
Adds the photos you take in the Camera app to your Photos library, when you turn that on.
Turns the conversation partner's speech into text for the BrainSync server (on the iPhone when it supports that).
